title: Phase 55M promotes thirteen bounded implementation records and holds one future trial
summary: FTFN promoted thirteen Phase 55L and Phase 55N signals after a record-by-record publication review. The DARPA Lift Challenge record remains In Review because the August 2-9 field trial has not happened. The review preserves separate stages for awards, obligations, governance actions, oversight findings, software artifacts, construction milestones, procurement channels, preliminary drafts, tests, delivery, operation, and scale.
evidence_note: Promotion confirms that thirteen records are independently useful and adequately bounded. It does not convert financing into construction, a final-award notice into current recipient status, a capacity contract into an energized line, delivered fuel into reactor operation, a prototype ceiling into spending or delivery, a governance action into universal cancellation, an oversight gap into agreement failure, a testbed artifact into commercial interoperability, topping out into occupancy or production, a purchasing channel into adoption, or a working draft into a final deployed standard. The scheduled DARPA trial remains unpublished until official post-event evidence exists.
